leads.title: Lawrence v. Texas (2003) - U.S. Supreme Court
leads.documents: Decriminalization of consensual same-sex sexual activity in North Carolina; basis for unenforceability of state sodomy law.
leads.detail: Cited in text as 'U.S. Supreme Court ruling in Lawrence v. Texas (2003) held laws criminalizing consensual homosexual activity between adults unconstitutional.' No URL visible.

leads.title: State v. Whiteley (2005) - North Carolina Court of Appeals / N.C. G.S. § 14-177
leads.documents: Narrows 'crime against nature' statute to minors, non-consensual/coercive conduct, public conduct, prostitution; state sodomy law remains on books unenforceable.
leads.detail: Cited as 'State v. Whiteley (2005)' and 'N.C. G.S. § 14-177'. No URL visible.

leads.title: North Carolina Senate Bill 514 (2011) / Constitution Article XIV Section XVI Amendment
leads.documents: 2012 constitutional ban defining marriage as one man-one woman as only valid domestic legal union; vote margins and text.
leads.detail: Cited as 'North Carolina Senate Bill 514 (2011)' passed 30-16 Senate, 74-42 House, approved 61% to 39% May 8, 2012. No URL visible.

leads.title: General Synod of the United Church of Christ v. Cooper
leads.documents: Challenge to criminal penalty for presiding at marriage without license; Oct 10 ruling by Judge Max O. Cogburn, Jr. holding same-sex marriage ban unconstitutional.
leads.detail: Cited as filed April 28, 2014; ruled October 10 by District Court Judge Max O. Cogburn, Jr. No URL visible.

leads.title: Fisher-Borne v. Smith and Gerber v. Cooper
leads.documents: Second-parent adoption and marriage recognition suits; Oct 14 ruling by Judge William Osteen for plaintiffs recognizing same-sex marriage.
leads.detail: Cited as filed June 13, 2012 and April 9, 2014 in U.S. District Court for Middle District of North Carolina; amended after United States v. Windsor; ruled October 14 by U.S. District Judge William Osteen. No URL visible.

leads.title: Boseman v. Jarell (2010) - North Carolina Supreme Court
leads.documents: 5-2 ruling that state law did not permit second-parent adoption by second unmarried person; blocks adoption rights machinery.
leads.detail: Cited as 'Boseman v. Jarell' 2010 5-2; plaintiff Julia Boseman. No URL visible.

leads.title: Public Facilities Privacy & Security Act (HB2) / House Bill 142 repeal
leads.documents: March 2016 law preempting local LGBT hiring/bathroom protections and requiring bathroom use per birth certificate sex; partial repeal March 30, 2017.
leads.detail: Cited as 'Passed in March 2016' also known as 'HB2'; repeal of bathroom portion March 30, 2017 signed by Gov. Roy Cooper. No URL visible.

leads.title: House Bill 574 (2023) - trans sports ban
leads.documents: Bans transgender individuals assigned male at birth from female sports/athletic teams; veto by Gov. Cooper overridden August 2023.
leads.detail: Cited as 'House Bill 574' veto overridden August 2023. No URL visible.

leads.title: SB49 Parents' Bill of Rights (Effective August 15, 2023)
leads.documents: Requires educator parental notification if student requests different name/pronouns; bans instruction on gender identity/sexuality K-4; parental inspection rights.
leads.detail: Cited as 'SB49, known as the Parents' Bill of Rights' effective August 15, 2023. No URL visible.

leads.title: HB 805 (2025) / Lambda Legal birth certificate suit (Nov 2021 - June 26, 2022 ruling)
leads.documents: HB 805 defines male/female as only sexes effective Jan 1, 2026, requires amended birth certificates show original sex, bans state funds for transition care for minors/prisoners; prior 2022 federal ruling removed surgery requirement for marker change.
leads.detail: Cited as legislature override July 29, 2025 over Gov. Josh Stein veto; and 'June 26, 2022, federal judge ruled' after 'lawsuit filed by Lambda Legal in November 2021'. No URL visible.
